shouldFix.title: The successor repeats the historical honesty-block mutation that CLAUDE-V10-S2 was meant to cure: honestyRepairsFromV9 is changed after introduction even though honestyRepairsFromV10 is now the current successor block.
evidence: honestyRepairsFromV9 was introduced by frozen signed-index-trust-contract.v10. Four of its six entries differ in signed-index-trust-contract.v11. By contrast, honestyRepairsFromV1 through honestyRepairsFromV7 remain byte-identical to their introduction versions, and v11 correctly restores honestyRepairsFromV8 to its signed-index-trust-contract.v9 bytes.

Entry [1] replaces the explicit historical referent signed-index-trust-contract.v9 with the context-dependent phrase 'the predecessor'. Entry [2] rewrites the v10 record to qualify signed-index-trust-contract.v8. Entry [4] rewrites the v10 advisory record and replaces its C-plan clause. Entry [5] changes the speaker of the frozen v9-Codex-review record from signed-index-trust-contract.v10 to signed-index-trust-contract.v11 and adds blockers.

The frozen CLAUDE-V10-S2 required the CLAUDE-V9-M1 and CLAUDE-V9-S2 landings to remain in honestyRepairsFromV9, which it described as already correct, and expressly said it was not asking for honestyRepairsFromV9 to change. v11 instead mutates that predecessor block while also adding honestyRepairsFromV10 for current v10-to-v11 work.

basedOn.method says only honestyRepairsFromV1 through honestyRepairsFromV8 are historical. Once honestyRepairsFromV10 exists as the current block, honestyRepairsFromV9 is also historical under the lineage rule articulated by CLAUDE-V10-S2. Stopping the declaration at V8 permits the same defect to move forward by one generation.

The current facts do not require the mutation. honestyRepairsFromV10 already records the v10 advisories, the frozen Codex v10 ACCEPT 0/0 result, the four unlabeled Claude observationsNotFindings, and the v11 speaker.
shouldFix.whyItMatters: The repair restores one frozen historical block while erasing and rewriting the next one. A reader can no longer recover signed-index-trust-contract.v10's own account of the v9-to-v10 step from the successor, and current v11 claims are filed into both the V9 and V10 blocks. This is the same provenance defect class as frozen CLAUDE-V10-S2, not a dispute with the DR-112 state machine or the residual policy axis.

shouldFix.title: The Closed roster omits four actual v10-to-v11 changes, so its exhaustive non-roster equality claim is false.
evidence: A recursive minimal JSON comparison of frozen signed-index-trust-contract.v10 to the subject finds 39 changed paths, collapsing wholly added or removed subtrees to their roots. Four are outside every whole-path token in the 13-token Closed roster: the two reMeasurementAtV4 leaves and the first two appliesFindingsOf.notFoldedThisSuccessor members.

Both reMeasurementAtV4 leaves change the live speaker from signed-index-trust-contract.v10 to signed-index-trust-contract.v11. The v10 roster explicitly named /reMeasurementAtV4/standing and /reMeasurementAtV4/note; the v11 roster drops both while changing both.

The two appliesFindingsOf members likewise rewrite signed-index-trust-contract.v10 to signed-index-trust-contract.v11. The v10 roster explicitly named /appliesFindingsOf.notFoldedThisSuccessor; the v11 roster drops it while changing two members.

Even if appliesFindingsOf were treated as implicit succession metadata, reMeasurementAtV4 is a historical pin block, not succession metadata. Those two uncovered leaves alone refute the sentence that every path outside the roster or named succession metadata is the signed-index-trust-contract.v10 byte at that path.
honestyRepairsFromV10 does not disclose these four speaker rewrites. The subject's own review guidance says to attack any silent v10-to-v11 path outside basedOn.method / honestyRepairsFromV10.
shouldFix.whyItMatters: The closed delta ledger is the audit boundary that lets a reviewer distinguish targeted repairs from silent edits. Omitting real changes makes the closure assertion non-reproducing even though the omitted reMeasurementAtV4 statements are substantively accurate.
shouldFix.requiredRepair: Add explicit whole-path roster entries for /reMeasurementAtV4/note, /reMeasurementAtV4/standing, and /appliesFindingsOf.notFoldedThisSuccessor, or restore the frozen v10 bytes for any path that is not intended to change. Keep the exhaustive closure sentence only after every changed leaf is covered.
shouldFix.notRequested: Do not make reMeasurementAtV4 live, change its historical digests, change the live COORD or file-08 redirects, edit a frozen predecessor, or alter register standing.
